results.title: EU seeks clarification from Algeria over military deployment in Niger
results.snippet: The EU’s request follows the reported arrival of an Algerian military convoy in the Nigerien city of Arlit late last month. Located in northwestern Niger, Arlit is known for its uranium mining industry. The deployment has been described in reports as the first time Algerian troops have operated outside the country since Algeria supported Egypt during the 1973 Arab-Israeli War. [...] Friday 6 Novem
